entities.summary: Amy Atwell is an Australian professional basketball player for the Rockingham Flames of the NBL1 West. She played college basketball for the Hawaii Rainbow Wahine, where she won the Big West Conference Player of the Year in 2022. She had briefs stints in the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA) in 2022 with the Los Angeles Sparks and in 2024 with the Phoenix Mercury. Between 2022 and 2026, she had played for the Perth Lynx of the Women's National Basketball League (WNBL).
